description: Draft research method; unqualified and not published.

routing.when_to_use: A user asks to design or assess a prospective clinical study before protocol submission, including endpoints, feasibility, sample size, or phase decision support.
when_not_to_use: Do not use outside the task-specific scope described in SKILL.md.

required_inputs.name: request
required_inputs.description: Clinical question, intended population, intervention/comparator, design/stage, endpoints and follow-up, expected event/variance assumptions, recruitment/site constraints, regulatory/ethics context, and named clinical/biostatistical owner.

verification_steps: Check method fit and source traceability.

completion_criteria: Requested draft deliverables are present or missing inputs are named.
